title: Exact measured renamable Horn SAT and sparse witness search
claims: ExactRenamableHornSAT checks P membership for the exact canonical satisfiable renamable Horn language.
ExactRenamableHornGuard checks polynomial-time recognition of canonical renamability.
MeasuredHornPairEncoding checks construction of the 2-CNF that characterizes sign renamability.
MeasuredCNFRenaming checks exact measured sign renaming of canonical CNF.
RenamableHornSATSearch checks sparse satisfying assignment recovery for the renamable Horn restriction.

experiments.purpose: Bind the archived Lean modules and exact statements to the recorded local reference replay. The isolated experiment reports zero Lean invocations and can be complemented by replay with the pinned reference.
